## Specification

### Component: Accordion (and Collapsible)

A stack of headings that each reveal a region, plus `Collapsible` for a single region. Both share one animated region (`Collapse`).

#### Anatomy
```
<Accordion type="single|multiple" variant>      div.ui-accordion data-variant
  <AccordionItem value disabled>                div.ui-accordion-item data-state
    <AccordionTrigger headingLevel=3>           h3.ui-accordion-header > button.ui-accordion-trigger[data-accordion-trigger]
                                                  children + chevron-down icon (.ui-accordion-chevron)
    <AccordionContent>                          div.ui-collapse.ui-accordion-content role="region"
                                                  > div.ui-collapse-inner > div.ui-accordion-body
<Collapsible open|defaultOpen onOpenChange disabled>   div.ui-collapsible
  <CollapsibleTrigger asChild?>                 button, aria-expanded, aria-controls
  <CollapsibleContent>                          div.ui-collapse.ui-collapsible-content
```

#### Props
- `Accordion` is a union: `type="single"` (`value?: string`, `defaultValue`, `onValueChange(value: string)`, `collapsible` default false) or `type="multiple"` (`string[]` equivalents). Also `variant` (`default` divided | `cards` | `flush`) and `disabled`. State is held as `string[]` internally via `useControllableState`; single without `collapsible` ignores a click on the open item.
- `AccordionItem`: `value`, `disabled`. `AccordionTrigger`: `headingLevel` 2–6.
- `Collapsible`: `open`, `defaultOpen`, `onOpenChange`, `disabled`.

#### Behaviour
- Trigger `aria-expanded`, `aria-controls` = region id; region `aria-labelledby` = trigger id. Ids from `useId()` + sanitised value.
- Keyboard (APG): ArrowUp/ArrowDown/Home/End move focus between triggers (wrapping), only when the key is pressed on a trigger (fields inside panels keep their keys). Enter/Space toggles (native button).
- Closed content stays in the DOM with `hidden="until-found"` (set only after the closing animation finishes, via `animationsFinished`), so Ctrl+F can reveal it; the `beforematch` event opens the item. Browsers without support treat it as plain `hidden`. An item that starts open does not animate on mount (`data-animate` is added after the first commit).

#### Visual rules
- Region: `display: grid; grid-template-rows: 0fr` (open: `1fr`); inner `min-height: 0; overflow: hidden`.
- Trigger: flex, space-between, 15px/500, padding 16px 0, chevron 16px muted that rotates 180° when expanded.
- default: `border-bottom: 1px solid --ui-border` per item. cards: gap 8px, 1px border, `--radius-lg`, `--ui-surface`, open item border `--ui-border-strong`, trigger padding 14/16px. flush: no lines, trigger padding 10px 0.
- Body: 14px `--ui-muted-foreground`, bottom padding 16px (cards: 0 16px 16px).

#### Motion
- Open: keyframes `ui-collapse-open` (`grid-template-rows` 0fr→1fr + opacity) for `--ui-spring-smooth-duration` on `--ui-spring-smooth` (no overshoot). Close: 260ms `--ui-ease-in-out`. Chevron: `transform` 220ms `--ui-ease-out`. Reduced motion: no movement.

#### Accessibility
- WAI-ARIA accordion pattern. Disabled items are disabled buttons (skipped by arrows).

#### Acceptance checks
- Height ends at the content height (open) or 0 (closed, then hidden); no jump at the end.
- Single: opening one closes the other; collapsible lets the open one close.
- Arrow/Home/End move focus; Ctrl+F in Chromium opens a closed item containing the match.

### `ui/components/accordion/accordion.tsx`

```tsx
'use client';

import {
  createContext,
  forwardRef,
  useCallback,
  useContext,
  useId,
  type ButtonHTMLAttributes,
  type HTMLAttributes,
  type KeyboardEvent,
  type MouseEvent,
} from 'react';
import { cn } from '../../lib/cn';
import { useControllableState } from '../../hooks/use-controllable-state';
import { useRovingFocus } from '../../hooks/use-roving-focus';
import { Icon } from '../../icons/icon';
import { Collapse } from './collapse';

export type AccordionVariant = 'default' | 'cards' | 'flush';

interface AccordionContextValue {
  open: string[];
  toggle: (value: string) => void;
  setItemOpen: (value: string, open: boolean) => void;
  disabled: boolean;
  baseId: string;
}

const AccordionContext = createContext<AccordionContextValue | null>(null);

function useAccordionContext(component: string) {
  const ctx = useContext(AccordionContext);
  if (!ctx) throw new Error(`<${component}> must be used inside <Accordion>.`);
  return ctx;
}

interface AccordionItemContextValue {
  value: string;
  open: boolean;
  disabled: boolean;
  triggerId: string;
  contentId: string;
}

const AccordionItemContext = createContext<AccordionItemContextValue | null>(null);

function useItemContext(component: string) {
  const ctx = useContext(AccordionItemContext);
  if (!ctx) throw new Error(`<${component}> must be used inside <AccordionItem>.`);
  return ctx;
}

/** Ids must stay valid for aria-controls / aria-labelledby whatever the value looks like. */
const slug = (value: string) => value.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/g, '_');
const toArray = (v: string | string[] | undefined) => (v === undefined ? undefined : Array.isArray(v) ? v : v ? [v] : []);

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

interface AccordionBaseProps extends Omit<HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>, 'defaultValue' | 'onChange'> {
  /** `default` (divided), `cards` (separated) or `flush`. Default `default`. */
  variant?: AccordionVariant;
  /** Disable every item. */
  disabled?: boolean;
}

export interface AccordionSingleProps extends AccordionBaseProps {
  /** One item open at a time. */
  type: 'single';
  /** Let the open item be closed again. Default false. */
  collapsible?: boolean;
  value?: string;
  defaultValue?: string;
  onValueChange?: (value: string) => void;
}

export interface AccordionMultipleProps extends AccordionBaseProps {
  /** Any number of items open at once. */
  type: 'multiple';
  value?: string[];
  defaultValue?: string[];
  onValueChange?: (value: string[]) => void;
}

export type AccordionProps = AccordionSingleProps | AccordionMultipleProps;

/**
 * Accordion — a stack of headings that each reveal a region. Up/Down/Home/End
 * move between headers (WAI-ARIA accordion pattern).
 */
export const Accordion = forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, AccordionProps>(function Accordion(props, ref) {
  const {
    type,
    variant = 'default',
    disabled = false,
    className,
    onKeyDown,
    // Pulled out so they are not spread onto the <div>
    collapsible: collapsibleProp,
    value: valueProp,
    defaultValue,
    onValueChange,
    ...rest
  } = props as AccordionProps & { collapsible?: boolean };
  const collapsible = type === 'single' ? collapsibleProp === true : true;

  const [open, setOpen] = useControllableState<string[]>({
    value: toArray(valueProp),
    defaultValue: toArray(defaultValue) ?? [],
    onChange: (next) => {
      if (type === 'single') (onValueChange as ((v: string) => void) | undefined)?.(next[0] ?? '');
      else (onValueChange as ((v: string[]) => void) | undefined)?.(next);
    },
  });
  const baseId = useId();

  const setItemOpen = useCallback(
    (value: string, nextOpen: boolean) => {
      setOpen((prev) => {
        const isOpen = prev.includes(value);
        if (nextOpen === isOpen) return prev;
        if (type === 'multiple') return nextOpen ? [...prev, value] : prev.filter((v) => v !== value);
        if (nextOpen) return [value];
        return collapsible ? [] : prev;
      });
    },
    [setOpen, type, collapsible],
  );
  const toggle = useCallback((value: string) => setItemOpen(value, !open.includes(value)), [setItemOpen, open]);

  const roving = useRovingFocus({ itemSelector: '[data-accordion-trigger]', orientation: 'vertical', typeahead: false });

  return (
    <AccordionContext.Provider value={{ open, toggle, setItemOpen, disabled, baseId }}>
      <div
        ref={ref}
        data-variant={variant}
        className={cn('ui-accordion', className)}
        onKeyDown={(e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
          onKeyDown?.(e);
          // Only arrow keys pressed on a header; fields inside a panel keep their own keys
          if (!e.defaultPrevented && (e.target as HTMLElement).closest('[data-accordion-trigger]')) roving(e);
        }}
        {...rest}
      />
    </AccordionContext.Provider>
  );
});

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

export interface AccordionItemProps extends HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement> {
  /** Identifies the item in the accordion's value. */
  value: string;
  disabled?: boolean;
}

export const AccordionItem = forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, AccordionItemProps>(function AccordionItem(
  { value, disabled, className, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  const ctx = useAccordionContext('AccordionItem');
  const open = ctx.open.includes(value);
  const isDisabled = disabled ?? ctx.disabled;
  return (
    <AccordionItemContext.Provider
      value={{
        value,
        open,
        disabled: isDisabled,
        triggerId: `${ctx.baseId}-trigger-${slug(value)}`,
        contentId: `${ctx.baseId}-content-${slug(value)}`,
      }}
    >
      <div
        ref={ref}
        data-state={open ? 'open' : 'closed'}
        data-disabled={isDisabled ? '' : undefined}
        className={cn('ui-accordion-item', className)}
        {...props}
      />
    </AccordionItemContext.Provider>
  );
});

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

export interface AccordionTriggerProps extends ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement> {
  /** Heading level that wraps the button, so the structure fits your page. Default 3. */
  headingLevel?: 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6;
}

export const AccordionTrigger = forwardRef<HTMLButtonElement, AccordionTriggerProps>(function AccordionTrigger(
  { headingLevel = 3, className, children, onClick, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  const ctx = useAccordionContext('AccordionTrigger');
  const item = useItemContext('AccordionTrigger');
  const Heading = `h${headingLevel}` as 'h3';
  return (
    <Heading className="ui-accordion-header">
      <button
        ref={ref}
        type="button"
        id={item.triggerId}
        data-accordion-trigger=""
        data-state={item.open ? 'open' : 'closed'}
        aria-expanded={item.open}
        aria-controls={item.contentId}
        disabled={item.disabled}
        className={cn('ui-accordion-trigger', className)}
        onClick={(e: MouseEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) => {
          onClick?.(e);
          if (!e.defaultPrevented) ctx.toggle(item.value);
        }}
        {...props}
      >
        {children}
        <Icon name="chevron-down" size={16} className="ui-accordion-chevron" />
      </button>
    </Heading>
  );
});

export const AccordionContent = forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>>(function AccordionContent(
  { className, children, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  const ctx = useAccordionContext('AccordionContent');
  const item = useItemContext('AccordionContent');
  return (
    <Collapse
      ref={ref}
      id={item.contentId}
      role="region"
      aria-labelledby={item.triggerId}
      open={item.open}
      onReveal={() => ctx.setItemOpen(item.value, true)}
      className={cn('ui-accordion-content', className)}
      {...props}
    >
      <div className="ui-accordion-body">{children}</div>
    </Collapse>
  );
});
```

### `ui/components/accordion/collapse.tsx`

```tsx
'use client';

import { forwardRef, useEffect, useRef, useState, type HTMLAttributes } from 'react';
import { cn } from '../../lib/cn';
import { animationsFinished } from '../../lib/dom';
import { useComposedRefs } from '../../lib/compose-refs';
import { useIsomorphicLayoutEffect } from '../../hooks/use-isomorphic-layout-effect';

export interface CollapseProps extends HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement> {
  open: boolean;
  /** Called when the browser reveals the region (find-in-page matched text inside it). */
  onReveal: () => void;
}

/**
 * The animated region shared by Accordion and Collapsible.
 * A grid whose single row animates 0fr to 1fr (CSS keyframes on the smooth
 * spring), so height follows the content with no measuring. The content stays
 * in the DOM when closed with `hidden="until-found"`, so find-in-page (Ctrl+F)
 * can open it where the browser supports that; elsewhere it is plain `hidden`.
 */
export const Collapse = forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, CollapseProps>(function Collapse(
  { open, onReveal, className, children, ...props },
  forwardedRef,
) {
  const elRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const ref = useComposedRefs(forwardedRef, elRef);
  // `hidden` is applied only after the closing animation has finished
  const [settledClosed, setSettledClosed] = useState(!open);
  // No animation on the first render (an item that starts open must not play its entrance)
  const animate = useRef(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    animate.current = true;
  }, []);

  useIsomorphicLayoutEffect(() => {
    if (open) {
      setSettledClosed(false);
      return;
    }
    let cancelled = false;
    animationsFinished(elRef.current, false).then(() => {
      if (!cancelled) setSettledClosed(true);
    });
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, [open]);

  // `beforematch` fires when find-in-page is about to reveal text inside the hidden region
  const reveal = useRef(onReveal);
  reveal.current = onReveal;
  useEffect(() => {
    const el = elRef.current;
    if (!el) return;
    const on = () => reveal.current();
    el.addEventListener('beforematch', on);
    return () => el.removeEventListener('beforematch', on);
  }, []);

  const hidden = !open && settledClosed;
  return (
    <div
      ref={ref}
      data-state={open ? 'open' : 'closed'}
      data-animate={animate.current ? '' : undefined}
      hidden={hidden ? ('until-found' as unknown as boolean) : undefined}
      className={cn('ui-collapse', className)}
      {...props}
    >
      <div className="ui-collapse-inner">{children}</div>
    </div>
  );
});
```

### `ui/components/accordion/collapsible.tsx`

```tsx
'use client';

import {
  createContext,
  forwardRef,
  useContext,
  useId,
  type ButtonHTMLAttributes,
  type HTMLAttributes,
  type MouseEvent,
} from 'react';
import { cn } from '../../lib/cn';
import { Slot } from '../../lib/slot';
import { useControllableState } from '../../hooks/use-controllable-state';
import { Collapse } from './collapse';

interface CollapsibleContextValue {
  open: boolean;
  setOpen: (open: boolean) => void;
  disabled: boolean;
  triggerId: string;
  contentId: string;
}

const CollapsibleContext = createContext<CollapsibleContextValue | null>(null);

function useCollapsibleContext(component: string) {
  const ctx = useContext(CollapsibleContext);
  if (!ctx) throw new Error(`<${component}> must be used inside <Collapsible>.`);
  return ctx;
}

export interface CollapsibleProps extends Omit<HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>, 'onChange'> {
  /** Controlled open state. */
  open?: boolean;
  /** Initial open state when uncontrolled. */
  defaultOpen?: boolean;
  /** Called when the region asks to open or close. */
  onOpenChange?: (open: boolean) => void;
  disabled?: boolean;
}

/** Collapsible — one region that opens and closes with a smooth height animation. */
export const Collapsible = forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, CollapsibleProps>(function Collapsible(
  { open: openProp, defaultOpen = false, onOpenChange, disabled = false, className, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useControllableState({ value: openProp, defaultValue: defaultOpen, onChange: onOpenChange });
  const id = useId();
  return (
    <CollapsibleContext.Provider
      value={{ open, setOpen, disabled, triggerId: `${id}-trigger`, contentId: `${id}-content` }}
    >
      <div
        ref={ref}
        data-state={open ? 'open' : 'closed'}
        data-disabled={disabled ? '' : undefined}
        className={cn('ui-collapsible', className)}
        {...props}
      />
    </CollapsibleContext.Provider>
  );
});

export interface CollapsibleTriggerProps extends ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement> {
  /** Use your own element (for example a <Button>) as the trigger. */
  asChild?: boolean;
}

export const CollapsibleTrigger = forwardRef<HTMLButtonElement, CollapsibleTriggerProps>(function CollapsibleTrigger(
  { asChild, onClick, disabled, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  const ctx = useCollapsibleContext('CollapsibleTrigger');
  const Comp = asChild ? Slot : 'button';
  const isDisabled = disabled ?? ctx.disabled;
  return (
    <Comp
      ref={ref}
      type={asChild ? undefined : 'button'}
      id={ctx.triggerId}
      aria-expanded={ctx.open}
      aria-controls={ctx.contentId}
      data-state={ctx.open ? 'open' : 'closed'}
      disabled={isDisabled || undefined}
      onClick={(e: MouseEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) => {
        onClick?.(e);
        if (!e.defaultPrevented) ctx.setOpen(!ctx.open);
      }}
      {...props}
    />
  );
});

export const CollapsibleContent = forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>>(function CollapsibleContent(
  { className, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  const ctx = useCollapsibleContext('CollapsibleContent');
  return (
    <Collapse
      ref={ref}
      id={ctx.contentId}
      open={ctx.open}
      onReveal={() => ctx.setOpen(true)}
      className={cn('ui-collapsible-content', className)}
      {...props}
    />
  );
});
```

### `ui/hooks/use-controllable-state.ts`

```ts
'use client';

import { useCallback, useRef, useState } from 'react';

/**
 * State that can be controlled (`value` + `onChange`) or uncontrolled
 * (`defaultValue`). Every stateful component uses this so the two modes
 * behave identically.
 */
export function useControllableState<T>({
  value,
  defaultValue,
  onChange,
}: {
  value?: T;
  defaultValue: T;
  onChange?: (value: T) => void;
}): [T, (next: T | ((prev: T) => T)) => void] {
  const [internal, setInternal] = useState<T>(defaultValue);
  const controlled = value !== undefined;
  const current = controlled ? (value as T) : internal;
  const currentRef = useRef(current);
  currentRef.current = current;
  const onChangeRef = useRef(onChange);
  onChangeRef.current = onChange;

  const setValue = useCallback(
    (next: T | ((prev: T) => T)) => {
      const resolved = typeof next === 'function' ? (next as (prev: T) => T)(currentRef.current) : next;
      if (Object.is(resolved, currentRef.current)) return;
      currentRef.current = resolved;
      if (!controlled) setInternal(resolved);
      onChangeRef.current?.(resolved);
    },
    [controlled],
  );

  return [current, setValue];
}
```

### `ui/hooks/use-roving-focus.ts`

```ts
'use client';

import { useCallback, useRef, type KeyboardEvent } from 'react';

export type Orientation = 'vertical' | 'horizontal' | 'both';

const isDisabled = (el: HTMLElement) =>
  el.hasAttribute('disabled') || el.getAttribute('aria-disabled') === 'true' || el.hasAttribute('data-disabled');

/**
 * Arrow-key focus movement across items inside a container, with Home/End
 * and typeahead. Spread the returned handler on the container:
 *   const onKeyDown = useRovingFocus({ itemSelector: '[role="menuitem"]' });
 *   <div role="menu" onKeyDown={onKeyDown}>…</div>
 */
export function useRovingFocus({
  itemSelector,
  orientation = 'vertical',
  loop = true,
  typeahead = true,
  onMove,
}: {
  itemSelector: string;
  orientation?: Orientation;
  loop?: boolean;
  typeahead?: boolean;
  onMove?: (item: HTMLElement) => void;
}) {
  const buffer = useRef('');
  const timer = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined>(undefined);

  return useCallback(
    (e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLElement>) => {
      const items = Array.from(e.currentTarget.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(itemSelector)).filter(
        (el) => !isDisabled(el) && el.getClientRects().length > 0,
      );
      if (!items.length) return;
      const active = document.activeElement as HTMLElement | null;
      const index = items.findIndex((el) => el === active || (active !== null && el.contains(active)));
      const go = (item: HTMLElement | undefined) => {
        if (!item) return;
        e.preventDefault();
        item.focus();
        onMove?.(item);
      };
      const step = (delta: number) => {
        if (index === -1) return items[delta > 0 ? 0 : items.length - 1];
        let next = index + delta;
        if (loop) next = (next + items.length) % items.length;
        else next = Math.max(0, Math.min(items.length - 1, next));
        return items[next];
      };
      const v = orientation !== 'horizontal';
      const h = orientation !== 'vertical';
      switch (e.key) {
        case 'ArrowDown':
          if (v) go(step(1));
          return;
        case 'ArrowUp':
          if (v) go(step(-1));
          return;
        case 'ArrowRight':
          if (h) go(step(1));
          return;
        case 'ArrowLeft':
          if (h) go(step(-1));
          return;
        case 'Home':
          go(items[0]);
          return;
        case 'End':
          go(items[items.length - 1]);
          return;
      }
      if (!typeahead || e.key.length !== 1 || e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey || e.altKey) return;
      if ((e.target as HTMLElement).matches('input, textarea')) return;
      clearTimeout(timer.current);
      buffer.current += e.key.toLowerCase();
      timer.current = setTimeout(() => {
        buffer.current = '';
      }, 500);
      go(items.find((el) => (el.textContent ?? '').trim().toLowerCase().startsWith(buffer.current)));
    },
    [itemSelector, orientation, loop, typeahead, onMove],
  );
}
```

### `ui/icons/icon.tsx`

```tsx
import { forwardRef, type SVGProps } from 'react';
import { cn } from '../lib/cn';
import { iconPaths, type IconName } from './paths';

export interface IconProps extends Omit<SVGProps<SVGSVGElement>, 'ref'> {
  /** Icon shape. */
  name: IconName;
  /** Pixel size (width and height). Default 16. */
  size?: number | string;
  /** Stroke width. Default 1.75. */
  strokeWidth?: number;
  /** Accessible label. Without it the icon is decorative (aria-hidden). */
  label?: string;
}

/**
 * Built-in stroke icon. Inherits `currentColor`.
 *   <Icon name="check" />   <Icon name="search" size={20} label="Search" />
 * Server Component–safe.
 */
export const Icon = forwardRef<SVGSVGElement, IconProps>(function Icon(
  { name, size = 16, strokeWidth = 1.75, label, className, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  return (
    <svg
      ref={ref}
      xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
      viewBox="0 0 24 24"
      width={size}
      height={size}
      fill="none"
      stroke="currentColor"
      strokeWidth={strokeWidth}
      strokeLinecap="round"
      strokeLinejoin="round"
      aria-hidden={label ? undefined : true}
      aria-label={label}
      role={label ? 'img' : undefined}
      focusable="false"
      className={cn('ui-icon', className)}
      // Static, library-owned SVG markup — never user input.
      dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: iconPaths[name] }}
      {...props}
    />
  );
});

export { iconPaths, type IconName };
```

### `ui/lib/cn.ts`

```ts
/**
 * Join class names, skipping falsy values.
 * No tailwind-merge needed: ui-* classes live in Tailwind's `components`
 * layer, so any utility passed in `className` already wins.
 */
export type ClassValue = string | number | false | null | undefined;

export function cn(...classes: ClassValue[]): string {
  let out = '';
  for (const c of classes) {
    if (!c) continue;
    out = out ? `${out} ${c}` : String(c);
  }
  return out;
}
```

### `ui/lib/compose-refs.ts`

```ts
import { useCallback, type Ref, type RefCallback } from 'react';

type PossibleRef<T> = Ref<T> | undefined;

function setRef<T>(ref: PossibleRef<T>, value: T | null) {
  if (typeof ref === 'function') ref(value);
  else if (ref) (ref as { current: T | null }).current = value;
}

/** Merge several refs into one callback ref. */
export function composeRefs<T>(...refs: PossibleRef<T>[]): RefCallback<T> {
  return (node) => {
    for (const ref of refs) setRef(ref, node);
  };
}

/** Memoised composeRefs for use inside components. */
export function useComposedRefs<T>(...refs: PossibleRef<T>[]): RefCallback<T> {
  // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  return useCallback(composeRefs(...refs), refs);
}
```

### `ui/lib/dom.ts`

```ts
/** True when rendering on the server (no DOM). */
export const isServer = typeof window === 'undefined';

/** Resolve once every animation on `el` (and its subtree) has finished. */
export function animationsFinished(el: Element | null, subtree = true): Promise<void> {
  if (!el || typeof el.getAnimations !== 'function') return Promise.resolve();
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    // Wait a frame so animations triggered by the state change have started.
    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      const anims = el.getAnimations({ subtree });
      if (!anims.length) return resolve();
      Promise.allSettled(anims.map((a) => a.finished)).then(() => resolve());
    });
  });
}

export function prefersReducedMotion(): boolean {
  return !isServer && window.matchMedia?.('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches === true;
}
```

```tsx
  cloneElement,
  forwardRef,
  isValidElement,
  type HTMLAttributes,
  type ReactElement,
  type ReactNode,
  type Ref,
} from 'react';
import { cn } from './cn';
import { composeRefs } from './compose-refs';

/**
 * Slot — renders its single child instead of its own element, merging props.
 * Powers `asChild`: <Button asChild><a href="/">Home</a></Button>.
 * Event handlers are chained (child first), className is joined, style merged.
 */
export interface SlotProps extends HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement> {
  children?: ReactNode;
}

type AnyProps = Record<string, unknown>;

const LAZY = Symbol.for('react.lazy');

/**
 * In React Server Components, children passed into a client component can arrive
 * as lazy references. Unwrap them with React.use (React 19) before cloning.
 */
function resolveLazy(node: ReactNode): ReactNode {
  const maybe = node as { $$typeof?: symbol; _payload?: unknown } | null;
  const use = (React as unknown as { use?: (p: unknown) => ReactNode }).use;
  if (maybe && typeof maybe === 'object' && maybe.$$typeof === LAZY && typeof use === 'function') {
    return use(maybe._payload);
  }
  return node;
}

function mergeProps(slotProps: AnyProps, childProps: AnyProps): AnyProps {
  const merged: AnyProps = { ...slotProps, ...childProps };
  for (const key of Object.keys(slotProps)) {
    const slotValue = slotProps[key];
    const childValue = childProps[key];
    if (/^on[A-Z]/.test(key) && typeof slotValue === 'function' && typeof childValue === 'function') {
      merged[key] = (...args: unknown[]) => {
        (childValue as (...a: unknown[]) => void)(...args);
        (slotValue as (...a: unknown[]) => void)(...args);
      };
    } else if (key === 'className') {
      merged[key] = cn(slotValue as string, childValue as string);
    } else if (key === 'style') {
      merged[key] = { ...(slotValue as object), ...(childValue as object) };
    }
  }
  return merged;
}

export const Slot = forwardRef<HTMLElement, SlotProps>(function Slot({ children, ...props }, ref) {
  const child = resolveLazy(Children.only(resolveLazy(children) as ReactElement));
  if (!isValidElement(child)) return null;
  const element = child as ReactElement<AnyProps & { ref?: Ref<HTMLElement> }>;
  // React 19 exposes ref as a prop; React 18 keeps it on the element.
  const childRef = (element.props.ref ?? (element as unknown as { ref?: Ref<HTMLElement> }).ref) as Ref<HTMLElement> | undefined;
  return cloneElement(element, {
    ...mergeProps(props as AnyProps, element.props),
    ref: ref ? composeRefs(ref, childRef) : childRef,
  });
});
```

### `ui/styles/components/accordion.css`

```css
/* Accordion + Collapsible --------------------------------------------------
   <div class="ui-accordion" data-variant="default|cards|flush">
     <div class="ui-accordion-item" data-state="open|closed">
       <h3 class="ui-accordion-header"><button class="ui-accordion-trigger"> … .ui-accordion-chevron
       <div class="ui-collapse ui-accordion-content">           grid, row animates 0fr to 1fr
         <div class="ui-collapse-inner"><div class="ui-accordion-body">
   Collapsible: .ui-collapsible > trigger + .ui-collapse.ui-collapsible-content
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------ */

@keyframes ui-collapse-open { from { grid-template-rows: 0fr; opacity: 0; } to { grid-template-rows: 1fr; opacity: 1; } }
@keyframes ui-collapse-close { from { grid-template-rows: 1fr; opacity: 1; } to { grid-template-rows: 0fr; opacity: 0; } }

@layer components {
  /* The animated region (shared) */
  .ui-collapse { display: grid; grid-template-rows: 0fr; }
  .ui-collapse[data-state="open"] { grid-template-rows: 1fr; }
  .ui-collapse-inner { min-height: 0; overflow: hidden; }
  .ui-collapse[data-animate][data-state="open"] {
    animation: ui-collapse-open var(--ui-spring-smooth-duration) var(--ui-spring-smooth) both;
  }
  /* Closing is quicker than opening */
  .ui-collapse[data-animate][data-state="closed"] {
    animation: ui-collapse-close 260ms var(--ui-ease-in-out) both;
  }

  /* ---- accordion ---- */
  .ui-accordion { display: grid; width: 100%; }
  .ui-accordion-header { display: flex; margin: 0; font-size: inherit; font-weight: inherit; }
  .ui-accordion-trigger {
    flex: 1;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 1rem;
    padding: 1rem 0;
    text-align: start;
    font-size: var(--text-md);
    line-height: 1.5rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    color: var(--ui-foreground);
    cursor: pointer;
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
    transition: color var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard), background-color var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard);
  }
  .ui-accordion-trigger:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }
  .ui-accordion-trigger:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-ring) 45%, transparent); }
  .ui-accordion-chevron {
    flex: none;
    color: var(--ui-muted-foreground);
    transition: transform var(--ui-duration) var(--ui-ease-out);
  }
  .ui-accordion-trigger[aria-expanded="true"] .ui-accordion-chevron { transform: rotate(180deg); }
  @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
    .ui-accordion-trigger:not(:disabled):hover .ui-accordion-chevron { color: var(--ui-foreground); }
  }
  .ui-accordion-body { padding-bottom: 1rem; font-size: var(--text-base); color: var(--ui-muted-foreground); }

  /* default: divided */
  .ui-accordion[data-variant="default"] > .ui-accordion-item { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ui-border); }

  /* cards: separated surfaces */
  .ui-accordion[data-variant="cards"] { gap: 0.5rem; }
  .ui-accordion[data-variant="cards"] > .ui-accordion-item {
    border: 1px solid var(--ui-border);
    border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
    background: var(--ui-surface);
    color: var(--ui-surface-foreground);
    transition: border-color var(--ui-duration) var(--ui-ease-standard), background-color var(--ui-duration) var(--ui-ease-standard);
  }
  .ui-accordion[data-variant="cards"] > .ui-accordion-item[data-state="open"] { border-color: var(--ui-border-strong); }
  .ui-accordion[data-variant="cards"] > .ui-accordion-item > .ui-accordion-header > .ui-accordion-trigger { padding: 0.875rem 1rem; border-radius: var(--radius-lg); }
  .ui-accordion[data-variant="cards"] .ui-accordion-body { padding: 0 1rem 1rem; }

  /* flush: no lines, tight */
  .ui-accordion[data-variant="flush"] .ui-accordion-trigger { padding: 0.625rem 0; }
  .ui-accordion[data-variant="flush"] .ui-accordion-body { padding-bottom: 0.75rem; }

  /* ---- collapsible ---- */
  .ui-collapsible-content { font-size: var(--text-base); }
}
```

## Usage

**FAQ** — from the docs (`apps/docs/examples/accordion/faq.tsx`), imports rewritten to `@/ui/...`:

```tsx
import { Accordion, AccordionContent, AccordionItem, AccordionTrigger } from '@/ui/components/accordion';

const faq = [
  ['Can I change plans later?', 'Yes. Upgrades apply immediately and downgrades start at the next billing date. We prorate the difference.'],
  ['How does the 14-day trial work?', 'You get every Pro feature for 14 days with no card. We email you three days before it ends.'],
  ['Do you offer refunds?', 'Annual plans can be refunded in full within 30 days. Monthly plans are not refunded after the period has started.'],
  ['Where is my data stored?', 'In the EU (Frankfurt) by default. You can pick the US (Virginia) when you create a workspace.'],
];

export default function AccordionFaq() {
  return (
    <Accordion type="single" collapsible defaultValue="item-0" className="w-full max-w-lg">
      {faq.map(([question, answer], i) => (
        <AccordionItem key={question} value={`item-${i}`}>
          <AccordionTrigger>{question}</AccordionTrigger>
          <AccordionContent>{answer}</AccordionContent>
        </AccordionItem>
      ))}
    </Accordion>
  );
}
```
